title: The $225 Pebble Time 2 is a refreshingly fun smartwatch | TechCrunch
summary: Fitbit kept the watch’s servers and app store alive until mid-2018. Core Devices has since shipped a limited-edition Pebble 2 Duo watch and has now sold more than 25,000 of its Pebble Time 2 watches across 93 countries.
